original_test_intent: Measure M.2 sequential write bandwidth and IOPS using approved Windows CrystalDiskMark profile and compare displayed result with project specification.
original_method: Qualified operator records Windows, M.2 and tool identity, selects approved disposable target/test-file scope and sequential-write GUI profile, runs once, saves full result and health/events. Any fio proxy is a separately approved changed method using secure access and exact destructive bounds.
manual_activity: Qualified operator runs approved GUI write profile on designated disposable M.2 scope; user may separately approve a secure comparable fio plan.
required_inputs: Approved Windows SUT and CrystalDiskMark version/checksum
Exact M.2 model/serial/controller/namespace/drive plus disposable target/test-file scope and data-loss approval
Sequential-write profile, size/count/cache/power settings and duration
Versioned write MB/s/IOPS thresholds and tolerance
Health/thermal abort and cleanup; if proxy proposed, equivalence and secure execution plan
safety_requirements: Verify exact target/write scope before GUI Start
Never use OS/boot/production/in-use target without explicit safe file behavior
Do not run proxy without equivalence, secure authentication and destructive approval
Stop on wrong target, device/thermal error or unclear comparability; no retry/format/restore
agent_execution_scope: Review GUI evidence and compare metrics with supplied spec
If alternate approved, review equivalence, secure settings, target mapping and full logs
Do not drive GUI, use unsafe SSH, silently substitute fio, execute destructive write or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Provide safe GUI target/profile/spec and operator
Approve or reject alternate fio method and destructive scope

modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Write cache, conditioning, filesystem/test-file behavior, queue depth, thermal state and OS I/O stack affect results.

project_override_considerations: Project may approve a fio alternate only with explicit comparability and safe target. It cannot be represented as GUI execution.
expected_evidence: Exact M.2 serial/controller/namespace/drive and approved write scope
Sequential-write GUI profile and unmodified screenshot/export
If proxy: approval, secure settings, exact target/range, full logs, cleanup and comparability decision

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The protected source consistently names CrystalDiskMark sequential write and spec comparison. DeepSeek's unsafe proxy is a review defect, not a source conflict; missing values are readiness inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: A qualified Windows operator can perform the source method when safe target/profile/spec are supplied; optional proxy availability does not determine review completion.

review_improvement: Preserves manual GUI coverage, exposes destructive scope and rejects unsafe/unproven proxy execution.
independent_technical_reasoning: Sequential writes can overwrite the selected file or block target and may quickly fill cache, making device state, size and duration important. Linux fio with one guessed profile does not prove CrystalDiskMark equivalence, and unsafe SSH compromises both execution trust and security. The authoritative path is operator GUI evidence unless engineering approves a separate mapped benchmark.
